professionalSummary.text: Candidate is a qualified Programme Manager with experience leading a regulated migration project.
professionalSummary.witness: Programme manager of record for the deposit platform migration at a retail bank from 2022 to 2025, signing the programme charter and the four wave go/no-go submissions to the executive steering committee; before that, four years as a project manager on the same bank's payments programmes.
